description: This file defines a class 'FilteredImplicitSubscriptionGrain' that is an Orleans Grain implementing an implicit stream subscription for specific stream namespace predicates. It manages stream subscriptions, logs received events, and maintains counters per namespace.

classes.name: FilteredImplicitSubscriptionGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain with implicit stream subscription based on a namespace predicate, maintaining counters for stream events.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Overrides the base method to set up stream subscriptions and initialize counters.

methods.name: GetCounter
methods.description: Returns the current count of received events for a specified stream namespace.
